Visited the Finger Cafe on 23.02.26. It's terrible for me. Maybe I ordered the wrong one. I bought the fact that shrimp in the gale 10 pcs for 94.000vd. And I ordered a pancake with mangoes and condensed. They brought a pancake. Decided to eat it while it was warm. Turned out to be completely cold, barely cutting with a knife. I thought the knife was dumb. The pancake was really stale. How can you ruin a pancake? Waited for the shrimp in tempura. The shrimp was hot, but practically only overcooked dry clare. Shrimp has to be found. It was as if they took the smallest shrimp, two centimetres, and stretched it into a thin thread. The clare itself is very dry and stiff, straight brown. Maybe someone will be lucky and have a good meal there, but I'm definitely not going again.

Disgusting food and service!!!!
Apr 2025 • Family
It's just something terrible. 
We were last year, then it was normal. But what I saw yesterday is a nightmare, the place is clearly time to close!!!!
First, unsanitary!!! Everything in some kind of abandoned and murdered form, from dishes to walls!!!
THE FOOD IS DISGUSTING!!!! That year we always ordered cheese balls, and we were brought 9 delicious cheese balls, but yesterday we were brought 6 bread balls with a little extra cheese, and that's for 85,000 dong, tin!!!!! Spaghetti thawed into a plate like a pig. Chicken chopped patties from the children's menu, that year brought 4 pcs each delicious, this year 3 unleavened!!! And that's for 99000dong. The salads were sour and stale on a plate. 
I'm tormented by just a memory!!! Also, these guys who cook don't look like chefs. Snuck frozen patties past me trying to hide them in my pocket. What is this circus??? Is it a cafe or a bum?????
